title: An open dataset of gas adsorption in deformable metal-organic frameworks for direct air capture
abstract: arXiv:2508.03162v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Engineering economical and scalable processes for direct air capture (DAC) from humid air relies on atomistic modeling to search and identify promising sorbent materials from a vast chemical space. Machine learning has emerged as a powerful tool for predicting material properties in an efficient yet accurate manner, but these models require large sets of carefully curated training data. We present the Open DAC 2025 (ODAC25) dataset comprising nearly 60 million DFT single-point calculations for CO2, H2O, N2, and O2 adsorption in ~15,000 MOFs. ODAC25 introduces functionalized MOFs, high-energy adsorbate placements, and synthetically generated frameworks to maximize the versatility of models trained on the dataset. ODAC25 improves upon the accuracy of DFT calculations in previous works and applies engineering intuition from recent work regarding the treatment of adsorbate-induced MOF flexibility. translated_title: 面向直接空气捕集的可变形金属有机框架中气体吸附的开放数据集
translated_abstract: 构建经济且可扩展的直接空气捕集（DAC）工艺以从潮湿空气中捕集二氧化碳，依赖于原子尺度建模来从广阔的化学空间中搜索并识别有前景的吸附剂材料。机器学习已成为一种高效且准确地预测材料性能的强大工具，但这些模型需要大量经过精心整理的训练数据。我们提出了Open DAC 2025（ODAC25）数据集，包含近6000万次DFT单点计算，涵盖CO2、H2O、N2和O2在约15,000种金属有机框架（MOFs）中的吸附。ODAC25引入了功能化MOFs、高能吸附质放置构型以及合成生成的框架，以最大限度地提升基于该数据集训练的模型的通用性。ODAC25相较于以往工作提升了DFT计算的精度，并应用了近期工作中关于吸附质诱导MOF柔性处理的工程经验。我们发布了最先进的机器学习……
tldr: 该论文发布了ODAC25开放数据集，包含近6000万次DFT计算，涵盖CO2、H2O、N2和O2在约15,000种可变形金属有机框架中的吸附，并引入功能化MOFs、高能吸附质构型和合成框架以提升精度与多样性，为直接空气捕集领域的机器学习模型提供高质量训练数据。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the Open DAC 2025 (ODAC25) dataset, comprising nearly 60 million DFT calculations for CO2, H2O, N2, and O2 adsorption in ~15,000 deformable MOFs, introducing functionalized MOFs, high-energy adsorbate placements, and synthetic frameworks to enhance accuracy and diversity for training machine learning models in direct air capture.
